# FlightSweeper WebMCP Challenge Edition

> A synthetic, browser-local demonstration of bounded agent-operated flight purchasing. It cannot charge a card, contact a supplier, or create a real reservation.

## Primary

- [Challenge workspace](https://webmcp.flightsweeper.com/): Human and WebMCP interface.
- [Complete machine-readable page](https://webmcp.flightsweeper.com/page.md): Scope, capabilities, and safety model.
- [Agent tool manifest](https://webmcp.flightsweeper.com/agent-tools.json): Versioned WebMCP and remote MCP contracts.

## Policies

- [Terms](https://webmcp.flightsweeper.com/terms)
- [Privacy](https://webmcp.flightsweeper.com/privacy)
